description: Angular component for displaying and managing entity version history in a table with features like filtering, sorting, pagination, and version operations (create, restore, diff). Includes a data source class for fetching version data from a service.

classes.name: EntityVersionsDatasource
classes.description: Data source class for loading and managing entity version data, interfacing with the EntitiesVersionControlService.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Returns an observable of the entity versions array for collection viewer.

methods.name: loadEntityVersions
methods.description: Fetches entity versions based on parameters and updates internal subjects.

methods.name: fetchEntityVersions
methods.description: Performs the actual service call to retrieve entity version data.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns an observable indicating if there are no entity versions loaded.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Returns an observable of total number of entity versions.
